description: A whimsical flying dragon with a large, curved tail, two elongated wings, a head with a snout and teeth, legs with feathers/scales for flight, and circular eyes/pupils.

components: A large, curved, upward-pointing tail extending from the back of the dragon
Two elongated, pointed wings, one on each side of the body, with intricate details such as feathers or scales
A head with a long snout and sharp teeth (visible from the top)
Feathers or scales on the legs and feet, allowing for flight-like movement
Circular shapes representing eyes, pupils, and possibly internal structures like the chest cavity
Small circles symbolizing scales or patches of fur/feather covering the body
A series of small, interconnected arcs above the dragon's head to depict clouds or an atmosphere
drawing_instructions.composition: The composition should have the dragon flying across the canvas from left to right. The large tail and wings dominate the upper half, with the head and legs positioned towards the bottom center. The circular components (eyes, pupils, internal structures) are placed close to the eyes for clarity. The small arcs above depict clouds or an atmosphere behind the dragon.
drawing_instructions.intent: Create a whimsical flying dragon with clear composition and recognizable components.
drawing_instructions.revision_reason: The previous line drawing did not clearly represent a whimsical flying dragon.
